# Extensions

English | [中文](extensions.zh.md)

The extensions subsystem documents the [`inspector`](../../Modules/Community/experimental/inspector/README.md) service, which answers approved read-only queries about a running Host's services, events, tools, slots, and theme tokens. Dynamic package definition and mount tools are retired; recorded sessions that contain their tool calls keep replaying through the generic tool rows.
